description: This source file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application. It implements the main home screen using RecyclerView components: a horizontal top navigation bar and vertical content rails, each containing horizontal lists of focusable content cards. It includes setup methods for UI components, mock data generation, and detailed comments describing the UI design, accessibility, and theming aspects.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment displaying the home screen layout with navigation and content rails.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Model representing individual content items with ID, title, and image URL.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Model representing a content row with a title and a list of ContentItem objects.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout using view binding and returns the root view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the top navigation and content rails after view creation.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Configures the horizontal top navigation RecyclerView with category items and focus behavior.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Configures the vertical list of content rows with mock data.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up view binding reference to prevent memory leaks.
